entry.title: DermaGlow AI — AI-Powered Skincare Platform
entry.content:
DermaGlow AI is an AI-powered skincare platform designed to analyze user needs and support personalized skincare recommendations.

The project combines artificial intelligence, data-driven analysis, and software development to create a practical user-focused application.

Key areas

  • Artificial intelligence
  • Data analysis
  • Personalized recommendations
  • Web application development
  • User-centered design
entry.summary: DermaGlow AI is an AI-powered skincare platform designed to analyze user needs and support personalized skincare recommendations.
